claimText: Requests for flight plan changes involving a change of route with destination changed shall include aircraft identification, flight rules, description of revised route of flight to revised destination aerodrome including related flight plan data, beginning with the position from which requested change of route is to commence, revised time estimates, alternate aerodrome(s), and any other pertinent information.
rationale: Specific data content requirement for flight plan change requests regarding route changes with changed destination.
